deliverables: WP1 - Plutarch and Ply Maintenance, Compatibility & Developer Experience
Bug fixes, correctness improvements, and optimizations
Documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor MLabs
request.what: Annual funding for MLabs Core Tool Maintenance & Enhancement: Plutarch and Ply, including maintenance, compatibility, bug fixes, optimizations, documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,162,746 ada, consisting of 1,128,880 ada for Plutarch and Ply maintenance, compatibility and developer experience plus a 33,866 ada Intersect Budget Administration fee.

Plutarch is described as a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts via controlled compilation into UPLC, and Ply is described as helping serialize Plutarch scripts to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types.

MLabs says Plutarch and Ply have been extensively used in the Cardano ecosystem and reports at least 26 teams in the motivation section and at least 15 teams in the rationale section building with the tools.
MLabs states that Plutarch scripts rank among the smallest in its public cross-language benchmark suite while requiring comparatively low on-chain compute and memory, and provides a benchmark URL.

The proposal says the next funding period will prioritize critical breakages and serious vulnerabilities, protocol-era and hard-fork compatibility, bug fixes and optimizations, then documentation and developer-experience improvements.

The proposer argues that without continued maintenance, existing adopters could face more friction, migration risk, bespoke workarounds, avoidable rewrites, or expensive smart contract stack migrations.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation, audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

The document discloses prior related funding for MLabs and Plutarch/Ply, including prior treasury actions, Project Catalyst awards, and a previous 70,000 ada Intersect payment for Conway-era Plutarch updates.

Intersect says withdrawn funds will be administered through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified reserve and project-specific addresses, role-based approvals, oversight entities, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 1,162,746 ada for annual Plutarch and Ply maintenance and enhancement, submitted by Intersect on behalf of MLabs, with stated work priorities, prior-funding disclosures, Intersect process references, NCL compliance claims, and smart-contract-based treasury administration details.
